entities.summary: Sergei Yuryevich Svetlakov is a Russian comedian, film and television actor, TV host, producer, and screenwriter. He was a member of the KVN team "Ural Dumplings" from 2000 to 2009. Svetlakov is best known for appearing in the sketch-show Nasha Russia and his role as Evgeniy Pavlovich in the Yolki franchise.
